Last Saturday, Leo and Nina went to the noodle shop. The weather was rainy that day. Both of them like noodles and tea. What's more, the workers dug a deep pit for the pool.
Life is full of small surprises. There are always many people at the kitchen table. The noodle shop is one of the best places in the city. The positioning of the shelves makes the room look bigger.
Nina is interested in singing. Leo spent the weekend at the bookstore. Leo learned a lot about history. What's more, sheep were grazing quietly on the hillside above the farm.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the noodle shop by bike. Leo bought a dress at the shop yesterday. Nina's birthday is in February.
